concepts.quote: An all-zero row is fine; it just means the page has no links.
concepts.why: States the listed wrong rule that a page with no outgoing links can have an all-zero row; in the model such a page must get a 1/N row (and here the page actually has 5 outlinks, the zeros come from integer division).
Accepts a row that sums to 0, contradicting the rule that every row of the transition matrix must be a probability distribution summing to 1.
